extDesc.message: Replaces mysterious country codes automatically with the corresponding flag. The solution for Chromium users on Windows!

ignoredHelp.message: Flag fixing is disabled on the domain you add and all subdomains of that domain. If you enter a website URL, only its hostname is saved. The path does not affect which pages are excluded.

ignoredExample.message: Example: example.com also disables flag fixing on www.example.com and blog.example.com. Adding only blog.example.com leaves example.com and www.example.com active. https://example.com/page applies to all of example.com, not just /page.

reloadHelp.message: Reload open pages after changing this list. Embedded content on an ignored website is also excluded.

invalidDomain.message: Enter a valid domain or HTTP(S) website URL.

duplicateDomain.message: This domain is already on the list.

storageError.message: Could not read or save your settings. Please try again.

domainAdded.message: Website added. Reload its open pages to apply this setting.

domainRemoved.message: Website removed. Reload its open pages to enable flag fixing.

popupActive.message: Flag fixing is enabled on this website.

popupParent.message: This website is ignored through $1. Manage that domain in Settings to enable flag fixing here.

popupUnavailable.message: This page is not a supported website, or access to its address is unavailable.

popupReload.message: Reload this page after changing its setting. An exclusion applies to this hostname and its subdomains.
